thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a catalog priority cutover for a new model (new-opt-7b) to become the primary for text-generation. Target change window: 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC (our 16:00–18:00 change window). I want ops + runtime + QE ack before we start.

ashwin: ack from eng-runtime. Prepared rollback pins and a fast re-pin path. Can we confirm fallback ordering and canary percentages?

maria: Fallback ordering: 1) new-opt-7b (primary) -> 2) old-stable (tuned-6.9) -> 3) cpu-fallback (quant-4). Canary plan below. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/priority-cutover 

ashwin: perfect. also setting `eviction_threshold=70` on serving hosts for the window.

taylor: QE here — please paste deploy-bot command so we can watch the exact steps and start smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by maria at 2140001111: `/deploy catalog priority-swap --catalog text-generation --model new-opt-7b --canary 10 --change-window 2026-04-05T16:00Z`

sre-oncall: I'm on infra watch. Will suspend automatic scale-downs for 30m and mute infra alerts that are noisy during cutovers.

liz: QE checklist: smoke prompts at +1m and +5m, quality evals (BLEU/ROUGE-ish), hallucination heuristics. I'll post pass/fail counts.

darren: orchestration note: canary 10% for 10m, then ramp to 50% for 10m if metrics look good, final 100% pin after final verification.

maria: Rollout acceptance criteria (short): p95 latency <= 2.5s, error rate <= 0.5%, no quality regression on selected eval sets. If breached, rollback immediately.

taylor: added smoke eval set `opt7b-smoke-v2` to console so alerting ties to those queries.

deploy-bot: canary step complete — 10% canary active. Metrics snapshot: p95=1.8s, errors=0.09%, cost/token delta +1.8%

liz: smoke +1m: pass (0 failures). smoke +5m: pass. no hallucination pattern changes.

ashwin: ramping to 50% now (`/deploy catalog ramp --catalog text-generation --model new-opt-7b --to 50`)

deploy-bot: ramp complete — 50% traffic to new-opt-7b. Metrics: p95=1.9s, errors=0.12%, throughput nominal.

maria: Holding for 5m to watch heatmap. Finalize pin if stable. Rollback command (ready if needed): `/deploy catalog set-priority --catalog text-generation --model tuned-6.9 --priority 1`

taylor: tagging @sre-oncall for infra revert if any host-level anomalies.

sre-oncall: infra steady. No notable GC spikes or OOMs.

darren: prepping final pin. Will run `pin-lock` after confirmation to prevent auto-eviction.

deploy-bot: pin action executed by darren at 2140001320: `/deploy catalog pin --catalog text-generation --model new-opt-7b --priority 1 --locked true`

maria: Cutover completed and pinned. Thanks everyone. Please add latency/quality charts to the release note and flag any slow drift.

liz: Opening release note draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/2140001111-new-opt-7b-cutover — will attach smoke logs and eval diffs.

ashwin: one follow-up request: add `fallback_ttl_secs: 7200` to the priority entry so the variant auto-demotes if we see fast regressions within 2h.

maria: Added to catalog config: `fallback_policy: { order: [new-opt-7b, tuned-6.9, cpu-fallback], fallback_ttl_secs: 7200 }`

taylor: noted, closing thread. :tada:
